name: What factors should I consider when choosing an AI SEO provider for my criminal defense practice?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing an AI SEO provider for my criminal defense practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AI SEO provider, consider their experience with legal firms, especially criminal defense. Look for providers that offer transparent reporting, demonstrate an understanding of legal ethics in marketing, and emphasize human oversight alongside AI tools. Evaluate their track record, client testimonials, and their ability to customize strategies to your firm's specific needs and local market. A focus on data privacy and security is also crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing an AI SEO provider, consider their legal industry experience, transparency, human oversight, track record, customization ability, and data security.
